name: Instant RLUSD demo transfer without owner approval
description: Verifies the global transfer form settles an internal RLUSD demo payment using a recipient's registered wallet email or cell phone number.
steps: Open Transfers
Enter a registered recipient wallet email or cell phone number and destination country
Enter an RLUSD amount
Send the RLUSD demo payment
Review transfer history
expected: The payment shows Completed (Demo), the shop balance decreases, the recipient account identified by email or phone increases and no owner approval is requested.

name: Dashboard weekly and monthly performance
covers: sales revenue and gross profit totals
description: Verifies each dashboard performance period returns a date-scoped report.
steps: Open the dashboard
Select Last week
Select Last month
Select This month
expected: Each period displays its date range, revenue, stock costs, gross profit, margin and recorded sales count.

name: Supplier payments and international contact validation
description: Verifies supplier contacts accept valid international formats and supplier payments in ZAR and RLUSD reconcile both sides of the appropriate demo ledger.
steps: Add a supplier using a name and country only
Edit the supplier and save email Glen@gmail.com and international phone +27 82 123 4567
Try an invalid email and an invalid short phone number and confirm validation rejects them
Choose the supplier in Accounts Payable and pay a ZAR amount from the demo shop account
Open Wallet and deposit demo RLUSD into the store account
Choose RLUSD as the supplier payment currency and complete a payment within the available store RLUSD balance
Review the supplier's RLUSD balance and payment history and the shared transaction feed
expected: Valid supplier contact details are accepted and invalid ones are rejected. The ZAR and RLUSD demo payments each debit the correct store ledger and credit the supplier's matching ledger. The supplier RLUSD balance and payment history reflect the RLUSD payment, with paired debit and credit records in the shared activity feed. No real bank or blockchain funds move.

name: Personal ZAR and converted store RLUSD deposits
covers: card deposit credits RLUSD store wallet
cardholder name and final four only
ZAR source amount and RLUSD converted amount
description: Verifies card demo deposits can target the personal ZAR wallet or convert ZAR into the store RLUSD demo wallet using a current indicative FX quote, with the two balances kept separate.
steps: Open Wallet and load or create the personal wallet using its email
Choose Deposit and select Personal ZAR demo account
Enter a ZAR amount and card demo details, then submit
Confirm the personal ZAR balance increases by the ZAR amount
Choose Store RLUSD account (convert from ZAR)
Enter a ZAR amount and review the current indicative ZAR/RLUSD rate, converted RLUSD amount and quote timestamp
Submit the demo deposit and review the store RLUSD balance and shared transaction history
Confirm the personal ZAR and store RLUSD balances remain separate and on-chain balances are unchanged
expected: Personal deposits credit only the email-linked personal ZAR demo wallet. Store RLUSD deposits convert the ZAR amount using a current provider rate (RLUSD assumed 1 USD), credit only the converted RLUSD amount and record source ZAR, FX rate and timestamp. A stale or unavailable quote blocks the deposit. No card is charged and no real funds or tokens move.
